title: AWS Network Security: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: An embassy has several security checkpoints. Each one checks something different. A W S layers its security in the same way.

scenes.heading: Security groups vs NACLs
scenes.narration: These two get mixed up all the time. Security groups guard the instance, and network A C Ls guard the subnet. Security groups are stateful, and network A C Ls are stateless. Security groups only allow, but network A C Ls can also deny.

scenes.heading: Higher up
scenes.narration: Other tools go further. W A F inspects web requests, at layer seven. It can also rate limit noisy addresses. Shield helps against flood attacks.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva AWS security lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Security groups are stateful and allow only. Network A C Ls are stateless, with allow and deny. W A F protects at layer seven. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva AWS security lab.
